known_limits: no downstream worker or broker transaction is implemented
local sqlite evidence only; no distributed exactly-once guarantee
local-jsonl still records prepared effect reservations but not terminal transitions
risk_addressed: rev0625 prepared effects had no durable terminal transition evidence; rev0626 adds an append-only SQLite/WAL transition chain rather than mutating decision rows.
runtime_changes: ledger entry material version advanced to anonsync-replay-ledger-entry-v4-effect-transition-chain
new effect_transition_metadata and effect_transitions tables with unique effect key index
terminal transition requires a known prepared effect key and 64-hex result digest
transition hash chain verified on reload and by read-only snapshot verifier
CLI can append terminal transition via --ledger-effect-terminal-state and --ledger-effect-result-sha256
report counters now expose transition line count/head hash/rejections
